findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text
findings.body: `totpStep1` in the Lithuanian account bundle was replaced with "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian sentence on the OTP setup page. It should be a Lithuanian translation of "Install one of the following applications on your mobile:", or the key should be removed so the English fallback is used.

findings.title: Lithuanian login bundle gets an Italian string for loginTotpStep1
findings.body: `loginTotpStep1` now reads "Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:", which is Italian. Lithuanian users will see an Italian instruction on the login TOTP setup screen. Use a proper Lithuanian translation or drop the key so it falls back to English.

findings.title: Traditional Chinese text in the Simplified Chinese (zh_CN) bundle
findings.body: `totpStep1` was changed to "在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：", which is written in Traditional Chinese characters. The rest of the zh_CN file is Simplified, so this entry is inconsistent for zh_CN users. It should be Simplified, for example "在您的手机上安装以下应用程序之一：". The same wording already exists in the zh_TW bundle.

findings.title: account-ui message switched from {{n}} to {n} placeholders and a MessageFormat choice
findings.body: Every other parameterised message in this account-ui bundle uses i18next-style `{{0}}`, `{{1}}` and `{{2}}`. This entry now uses `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2}` and a Java `{2,choice,...}` pattern. i18next will not interpolate single-brace placeholders or evaluate a `choice` expression. If the UI renders this key through i18next, users will see the literal text "Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,...}". The same concern applies to the matching change in the admin-ui English bundle. The change appears to have been made only to satisfy the new sanitizer.

findings.title: English reference file path derived with fragile global regex replaces
findings.body: The English file path is built with `replaceAll("resources-community", "resources")` and `replaceAll("_[a-zA-Z-_]*\\.properties", ...)` on the full absolute path. If the English counterpart does not exist (a new locale directory, or `maven-resources-community` mapping to a non-existent `maven-resources` file), the plugin throws a bare RuntimeException instead of a MojoExecutionException or a readable message. Any unusual path layout can also mis-resolve the reference file. Resolve the sibling file in a more robust way and report a proper Mojo error.

findings.title: Anchor error message lacks key and file
findings.body: The message "Didn't find anchor tag X in original string" does not say which key or file it refers to. The `key` parameter is available but unused, unlike the "Illegal HTML" message. With dozens of locale files, maintainers cannot locate the offending translation from the build output. Include the key and file in the message.
